text:
Iris (People Ops): FYI Toronto (YYZ) hub folks 1: partial power outage reported on the north wing. Building ops have shut affected floors for safety. Please avoid coming in today unless you have an approved retrieval slot.

Sam (Facilities): Confirmed. Power company ETA 18:00. Affected floors: 5-7. Lobby and meeting rooms 1-4 remain open. Noise and emergency lighting only.

Priya (Eng): Im scheduled for an onsite whiteboard interview at 14:00  what should I do?

Iris (People Ops): Move interviews to virtual by default. Recruiting will auto-notify candidates. If an in-person is essential, we will book a partner room or coworking pass. DM if you need assistance.

Marcus (Security): Access note: badge readers on floors 5-7 will show "restricted." Do not tailgate. If you were onsite earlier and left gear on affected floors, sign up for a retrieval slot in the sign-up sheet.

TransitBot: Public transit note: TTC may have bus reroutes near front of building due to utility crews. Allow extra time.

Sam (Facilities): Retrieval window 16:00-17:30 for critical gear only. Slots limited to 8 people; bring badge and ID. We'll escort and provide chain-of-custody receipts. Sign-up link in the event page.

Iris (People Ops): If you traveled in today and now need to stay overnight, People Ops will cover one-night hotel up to CAD 160 if your one-way commute exceeded 80km. Submit receipts within 7 days with "YYZ outage" in notes.

Priya (Eng): Any coworking or quiet room options? I need a low-noise place for video interviews.

Iris (People Ops): Yes  we have day passes at Regus Dundas and a quiet room reserved at 9am-6pm for accessibility. Mark "quiet" or "coworking" on the outage RSVP form. Priority to accessibility and interviews.

Marcus (Security): If you require accessible parking or an escorted drop-off, mark "assistance" on the RSVP and we'll reserve a spot near the lobby.

Iris (People Ops): Expense snippet to paste into the claim form:
```
Expense: Hotel
Amount: CAD 145.00
Date: 2026-08-04
Category: Travel - Emergency outage
Notes: YYZ partial power outage - one-night hotel
```

Iris (People Ops): We'll update when power company posts an all-clear. If you need urgent help with travel or interviews, reply here or DM People Ops. Thanks for the quick responses everyone. :heartbeat:
